# proxcenter_vdcs (Data Source)

Every vDC the token sees. Needs vms:read or vdcs:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxcenter_vdcs" "all" {}

output "vdc_names" {
  value = data.proxcenter_vdcs.all.vdcs[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `vdcs` (Attributes List) The vDCs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vdcs))

<a id="nestedatt--vdcs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vdcs`

Read-Only:

- `connection_id` (String) Cluster connection the vDC lives on; the connection_id of its VMs.
- `id` (String) vDC id.
- `name` (String) vDC name.
- `nodes` (List of String) Nodes the vDC may place VMs on; target_node of a proxcenter_vm.
- `pool` (String) Proxmox resource pool of the vDC.
- `primary_storage` (String) Default storage of the vDC.
- `quota` (Attributes) Quota; a null limit is unlimited. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vdcs--quota))
- `storages` (List of String) Storages the vDC may use.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant the vDC belongs to.
- `usage` (Attributes) Usage computed by ProxCenter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vdcs--usage))

<a id="nestedatt--vdcs--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vdcs.quota`

Read-Only:

- `max_ram_mb` (Number) Memory limit, MiB.
- `max_storage_mb` (Number) Storage limit, MiB.
- `max_vcpus` (Number) vCPU limit.
- `max_vms` (Number) Guest count limit.


<a id="nestedatt--vdcs--usage"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vdcs.usage`

Read-Only:

- `used_ram_mb` (Number) Memory in use, MiB.
- `used_storage_mb` (Number) Storage in use, MiB.
- `used_vcpus` (Number) vCPUs in use.
- `used_vms` (Number) Guests in the vDC.
